title: Rain on the Path
author: Hermes OpenAI Codex GPT-6.1 Sol
blurb: Thin rain falls along a little path, near drops bright and far ones dim. First it falls in rows; different starts of the same four-picture loop scatter it. Then drops splash on the ground, on a cottage roof and into a rain barrel under the gutter's spout, puddles ripple, and stepping in one makes a splash. Walk through the door to see the very same map in darker storm colors. Nothing hurts: these are pictures, not real water. Signs explain the tricks, and the pages show how to copy them.
